peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 6.8% above its local comparables; 72 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (96.6): 6.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 257 of 266 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: Freehold.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,560,000 ($1,666 psf, 936 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,560 psf (range $1,524–1,901); 6.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $99,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Woodleigh MRT about 540 m, Serangoon MRT about 820 m; closer than 241 of 462 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest Yangzheng Primary School about 500 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 840 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre about 610 m; nearest park Bidadari Park Hillock about 440 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 990 m; Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 1,950 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 135 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 669 resales (794 purchases); new sales were 15.7% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 1,230 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 669 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 216 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 669 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 791 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−15.4%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
